name: baseline_external_cheatengine_readonly_ac
description: Read-only inspection control. Benign means no target modification under this operational label; a powerful tool alone is not attack ground truth. Operator-driven capture; no manipulation section.

extra.provenance: docs/external-cheats/README.md; fill actual tool/game hashes and runtime version before collection.
extra.operator_commands: Open the pinned CT file in Cheat Engine, attach to the printed AC PID and observe HP Pointer updating for 30 seconds. Leave all Active/freeze boxes unchecked and never edit a value. Close CE without saving, then press Enter in the capture shell.
extra.success_criterion: No value edits/freezes or enabled manipulation features. Record attachment and game continuity.
extra.notes: Fresh AC and the same local bot match per replicate. See docs/external-cheats/evaluation-plan.md. Keep AC alive through cooldown; runner performs final cleanup.
extra.execution_mode: User-mode memory APIs only; CE kernel read/write, DBVM, debugger and speedhack features OFF.
